name: Deep Diamond India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1993, Deep Diamond India Ltd is in the business of Gold and Diamond Studded Jewelry
keyPoints:
Product Portfolio:[1][2]
Company provides varied range of 18K real
diamond jewelry which are manufactured 
at its own facility. Company also offers 100% buy back on all its real diamond jewelry which includes:
Rings, Earrings, Pendants, Mangal Sutra Pendants, Bangles, Bracelets, Necklace 
sets, Nose pins, studs, solitaires, etc. 
Company also manufactures real diamond watches, belts, cufflinks, shirt buttons, 
etc. on order for men

cons: Stock is trading at 4.92 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 9.06% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 5.06% over last 3 years.
